description: This file defines an Android Activity named BigPictureSocialMainActivity. Its primary purpose is to set up the UI for displaying a big picture social notification and to cancel an existing notification. It includes methods for initialization and notification management, primarily focusing on displaying social content as part of an Android Wear notification style.

classes.name: BigPictureSocialMainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class for handling the display and notification cancellation for a social big picture notification on Wear OS.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; sets up the view and cancels a notification.
